description: Numbers behind goal calculation and goal limits. status says how far each is confirmed: provisional and unverified values must be replaced when a dietitian or primary source confirms them (decision 38, research/makro/2026-11-09-health-data-consent-and-goal-safety.md).

kcal_floor_female.source: Industry convention, chosen by Max 2026-11-09. No authoritative minimum for unsupervised adults was found.

kcal_floor_male.source: Industry convention, chosen by Max 2026-11-09. No authoritative minimum for unsupervised adults was found.

max_loss_kg_per_week.source: NHLBI booklet: 1 to 2 pounds per week (seen in a search snippet only). Chosen by Max 2026-11-09.

kcal_per_kg.source: Common convention for energy in 1 kg of body weight.

fat_min_energy_fraction.source: NNR 2023, total fat 25 to 40 E%, seen in a search summary only.

fibre_g.source: Value on the B Night goals screen. docs/MVP.md asks for the Nordic recommendation.

activity_sedentary.source: Common activity multiplier; no source retrieved.
